profile_text.body:
Beautiful.ai is an AI presentation platform built for enterprise teams, according to its website. The company says the product keeps every deck on-brand and ready to share across a company, and that it serves teams from sales to strategy. It offers AI-assisted deck building, professional templates, and auto-aligning Smart Slides, with more than 300 Smart Slide layouts available. The site says users can define brand colors, fonts, and logos once so slides adapt to them, and that shared themes keep team members consistent. Beautiful.ai was founded in 2016.

The site describes Create with AI as a context-aware workflow that starts from a prompt, a slide outline, or a document, generates a text-first outline for editing, then produces polished slides that can be iterated on slide by slide. The company positions this against free AI PowerPoint generators, which it says leave users to fix layout and design problems after a rough first draft. The site also lists data slides such as charts, graphs, timelines, and diagrams, and says decks can be built 10x faster. A 14-day free trial with unlimited access to all features is offered, with plans for individual users, small teams and startups, enterprise implementations, and one-time slideshow creation.

The site cites customer results: Paciolan cut presentation design time by 75% after switching to Beautiful.ai, and Cvent also cut presentation design time by 75%. It says IDC analysts used the product to reduce production time and surface new data insights. The product tracked here is Beautiful.ai itself, a presentation generation tool.
